# Exercise 1) Tidyverse: New Zealand

a)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(knitr)

data <- readRDS("nzge.rds")

table_data <- data %>% group_by(voting_type, election_year) %>% summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE))

kable(table_data,
      col.names = c("Voting Type",
                    "Election Year",
                    "Total Votes"))

```
b)

```{r}

data_2014 <- data %>% filter(election_year == 2014, voting_type == "Candidate") %>% group_by(candidate) %>% summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(proportion = votes / sum(votes)) %>% select(candidate, proportion)

kable(data_2014,
      col.names = c("Candidate",
                    "Proportion"))

```
